[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Valeo''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was the protégé of [[Kanoth|Lord Kanoth]]. Together with [[Dominique|Lady Dominique]], the three of them scoured [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in an attempt to advance the field of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and win notoriety, and Valeo would eventually join them in becoming part of the obscure Sith cult known as "[[The Unmasked]]".<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Valeo was first mentioned in the codex entry, "[[Dominique|Lady Dominique]]," in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was originally intended to be the third of five boss encounters in the operation, "R-4 Anomaly", but due to performance and gameplay issues during development, he was removed from the operation.<ref name="LotS" /> A character model for the boss exists within the game files, however.
